sources: https://www.fs.usda.gov/media/263354 (White River NF 2026 Campground and Day Use Area Operating Dates)
recreation.gov campsite catalog for 232160 (search/campsites API, read 2026-10-28)

hookups.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/recreation/mollie-b-campground ('40-foot maximum RV length. No hook ups available') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232160 ('electrical hook-ups are not available'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: 26 sites plus a host site. One RV with tow per site; most sites take one extra vehicle for a nightly fee. No boat trailers in the campground (park them at the marina). The Forest Service page also says sites suit 'tent and trailers under 32 feet'.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/recreation/mollie-b-campground ('The Mollie B Campground has 26 campsites plus a host site'; '26 campsites available to tent and trailers under 32 feet'; '40-foot maximum RV length') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232160 ('There is a maximum length of 40 feet for RVs'; 'One RV with tow per single site'; 'No boat trailers in campground') + WRNF 2026 table ('27/40''), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Bear-proof food locker at each site and bear-proof trash. Boat ramp at Ruedi Marina next door.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/recreation/mollie-b-campground ('Flush Toilet'; 'Potable water is available at this site'; 'There is a boat ramp near the campground at Ruedi Marina') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232160 ('flush toilets and drinking water'; 'Bear-proof food lockers are provided at each site'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: White River NF's estimated 2026 dates; water may be off before Memorial Day weekend and after Sept 30.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/media/263354 ('2026 Campground and Day Use Area Operating Dates ... These are estimated opening dates'; 'Mollie B CG 7,800 27/40' 5/13-9/30 $34 R Y'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Reserve on recreation.gov at least 2 days ahead; senior passes must be entered when booking (single sites). The site must be occupied the first night (held until 11 am the next day). 14 consecutive nights. 2027 reservation season May 13 - Sept 29.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/recreation/mollie-b-campground ('A fourteen day stay limit applies to this site and reservations are accepted') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232160 (rules reservationCutOff 2, maxConsecutiveStay 14; notices 'Campers must occupy the site the first night', 'Reserved Sites will be held until check out time (ELEVEN) the day following your arrival date') + /rates (Peak Season 2027-05-13 to 2027-09-29), read 2026-10-28

values.note: recreation.gov rate; the Forest Service page and 2026 table say $34 and that rates differ between weekdays and weekends. Extra vehicle charged nightly at the campground.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232160/rates (Peak Season 2026-05-13 to 2026-09-29 STANDARD NONELECTRIC 32; same 2027-2028) vs https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/recreation/mollie-b-campground ('Single Site: $34 per night'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Senior pass discount on single sites, entered at booking.

discounts.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232160 ('Any accepted senior passes must be entered for the discount at the time of booking for single sites only'), read 2026-10-28

note: Aspen-Sopris RD, White River NF: in the Ruedi complex on Ruedi Reservoir, 15 mi up Frying Pan Road from Basalt at about 7,800 ft; sites look out over the reservoir. Not to be confused with Molly Brown near Leadville. --Claude
summary: FS + rec.gov + WRNF 2026 table: confirmed 26 sites (+host), flush toilets, water, reservable, no hookups; added max 40 ft (agency), season 05-13 to 09-30, 2-day cutoff, 14-night limit, booking season, Senior discount. fees 0/0 -> 32/32 (rec.gov; FS says $34). Note rewritten.
flags: STATUS: FS page: 'Due to lack of water the campground is now closed for the 2026 season.' (also 'Site Closed' banner). A 2026 closure, not a permanent one; WRNF also closed Ruedi's ramp to motorized launching from Aug 4, 2026 for low water.
fees 0/0 -> 32/32: recreation.gov's 2026-2028 rate is $32; FS page 'Single Site: $34 per night' and the WRNF 2026 table '$34 ... Rates differ between weekdays/weekends'. Recorded recreation.gov's.
Missing phone: Aspen-Sopris Ranger District (970) 963-2266 (WRNF offices). recreation.gov's 970-927-0107 / (801) 226-3564 belong to the concessionaire (American Land & Leisure).
Website: recreation.gov only; add the FS page https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/recreation/mollie-b-campground.
Max length: FS and recreation.gov both '40-foot maximum RV length'; FS also says '26 campsites available to tent and trailers under 32 feet'. Both clear 23 ft. recreation.gov catalog spurs 25-60 ft.
Stay limit: recreation.gov also carries a 'maxStay 12 days Each Month' rule beside maxConsecutiveStay 14; FS says fourteen days. Recorded 14.
Count: FS 26 + host; recreation.gov text 27 standard sites; catalog lists 25. Kept 26.
Waterfront lakeview not re-audited (no change proposed): recreation.gov 'Sites at this campground open up to views of the reservoir'.
Pin 39.3762,-106.8129 = FS coordinate, ~104 m from the catalog centroid 39.37536,-106.81237. OK.
